knowledge_graph.title: Simplified Tax Inc.
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Locally owned and operated for more than forty years, we are Simplified Tax Inc, Sparta, WI's trusted name in tax planning and preparation. As a full service tax preparation service, we're here to meet any and all of your tax compliance needs, whether local, state, or federal! With tax season looming, oftentimes the mountain of tax work ahead of you can be absolutely huge and the prospect of doing all by yourself without help can seem overwhelming. Successful in large part due to the relationships we've formed with our clients over the years, we've made our name as a trusted local tax assistance service that takes every step under the law to maximize your deductions and save you money. Never fear another tax season again, call us today."
